title: Zelenskyy: 'Very difficult' for Ukraine to survive without U.S. military support
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Friday that it would be “very, very, very difficult” for Ukraine to survive without U.S. military support, both now as it tries to repel Russia's invasion and in the future after the war ends.

title: Ukraine-Russia war: Zelenskyy says he believes Putin is preparing for war against NATO countries
description: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy warned that Putin is preparing for a war against NATO next year, with plans to station 150,000 troops in Belarus. He expressed concerns about potential offensives towards Ukraine, Poland, or the Baltic countries, while highlighting the need for security guarantees.

title: EU Ministers to Discuss Ukraine War Amid US-Russia Talks
description: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas has called for a meeting with bloc ministers at the Munich Security Conference to discuss Trump administration relations and the Ukraine war. This comes after Trump's recent conversation with Putin and the US statements on Ukraine.

title: Pierre Poilievre, Chrystia Freeland rebuff Donald Trump’s call for Russia to rejoin G7
description: The country used to be part of what was known as the Group of Eight until other members suspended Moscow in 2014 over the invasion of Ukraine

title: Ukraine-Russia agreement must come through Trump negotiations, Zelenskyy says
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy appealed to President Donald Trump's history as a dealmaker on Friday, offering flattering words as he sought the U.S. president's leadership in negotiations that could end the Russia-Ukraine conflict.

title: The art of the deal? Zelenskyy says a Ukraine-Russia agreement must come through Trump negotiations
description: MUNICH (AP) — Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy appealed to President Donald Trump's history as a dealmaker on Friday, offering flattering words as he sought the U.S. president's leadership in negotiations that could end the Russia-Ukraine conflict.

title: Fact Check: Trump Says Russia Has Lost 1.5 Million Troops In Ukraine War
description: President Donald Trump makes an unevidenced claim about the human cost of the Russia-Ukraine conflict, as he attempts to broker peace between Kyiv and Moscow.

title: JD Vance threatens sanctions, military action if Putin rejects Ukraine peace deal
description: Vance told the Wall Street Journal that Trump would put everything “on the table” in potential talks, and that Washington could even use “military leverage” against Russia to force a deal.

title: Trump key to ending Russia-Ukraine war; will meet Putin only after peace plan negotiation with US, EU: Zelenskyy
description: Trump this week upended years of steadfast Washington's support for Ukraine, however, speaking on Friday, Zelenskyy says the United States, including the Biden administration, never saw Ukraine as a NATO member.

title: After meeting Zelenskyy in Munich, Vance says US seeks ‘durable peace’ in Ukraine
description: US Vice President JD Vance met Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Munich on Friday for crunch talks on ending Russia's war, as Kyiv insisted it wanted to hammer out a joint plan with Washington.
